description: Sends feedback the user has agreed to pass on to the ReplenishRadar product team, on the user's behalf. The report says what the user wanted and what happened, with no names, contact details, credentials, or store data beyond what the report needs. Sending the same message twice returns the first report and files no second one.

impact.description: Optional: how much this is holding the user back.

message.description: What the user was trying to do, what happened, and what they expected.

related_tool.description: Optional: the ReplenishRadar tool the feedback is about, by name.

type.description: bug: something is broken or wrong. suggestion: something the user wishes ReplenishRadar did. support: the user needs help. other: anything else.

name: rr_submit_feedback
